notes: Saving and loading game progress is simpler. Pressing a game's card loads the customer's progress, then starts the game about two seconds after it arrives; if the progress cannot load, the game starts anyway. Progress is saved whenever the game's save files change, and once more at sign-out and shutdown. RapTech no longer watches which programs are running: a game opened outside its card (for example from Steam's library) is not saved, the Games page no longer asks for a game's program, and the auto-save switch is gone because saving is always on. My saves asks the customer to close the game before loading or deleting.
